frequency_question: How often does the RBI implement a repo rate hike within a quarter when inflation precursors are elevated?
membership_rule: Includes all scheduled and unscheduled Monetary Policy Committee meetings of the Reserve Bank of India between 2010 and 2024 where policy rates were actively adjusted.
provenance_note: 9 cases named, 24 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (2.7x)
coverage_note: 9 named representative hiking instances within active tightening windows out of 24 total meetings in those specific cycles.
known_gaps: Excludes minor pauses during transitional phases where data was ambiguous.
skeleton: Total rate-hiking meetings in tightening phases divided by total tightening-phase meetings over structural inflation regimes since 2010.
multiplier: 9 hits out of 24 meetings across active tightening windows where advance signals (inflation prints above target band) were visible.
validity_reason: Central bank reaction functions to inflation targets remain stable across multi-year governor terms.
